findings.title: 8 Palestinians killed, several injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Anadolu cites a medical source reporting that the child wounded by Israeli gunfire on Saturday morning was a 13-year-old boy. This appears to corroborate the previously logged WAFA child injury. No additional casualty should be counted; injury severity and clinical outcome remain unknown.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: a 13-year-old Palestinian male was wounded by Israeli gunfire
findings.source_type: Established news agency reporting attributed to a medical source

bounded_discovery_context.method: Targeted news searches and direct inspection of revised Anadolu article; compared with 12 unique authenticated heartbeats from November 27 14:44 through November 28 01:44.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: November 28 update to previously logged November 27 article ID 4140045 adds medical-source attribution and age for the Saturday injury already captured in WAFA 177365 at 23:44. The age and medical-source attribution were not in the reviewed records.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Exact update time unavailable; newly recovered in this window, not proven first published within it. Underlying sources may overlap; do not claim independent verification or another injury. Friday casualty recap excluded.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; production remains authoritative.
